rationale: The stock is sitting at 89.5% of today's range, just 0.76% below the session high, after a massive prior-day plunge of ~21% on fundamental concerns (supply chain delays, debt load). Price is consolidating tightly near the high with low-volume candles and no clear directional momentum — the last five 1-minute bars show a narrow range with mixed closes. Going long risks a reversal from resistance near the session high with a negative fundamental backdrop; going short risks chasing a stock that has already recovered significantly from its low ($73.56) and is showing relative strength. The risk/reward is unclear in either direction given the choppy, high-spread consolidation at the top of the range.
